title: A vesicle opens to the gap
hook: Predict the next step, then trace the signal.

knows: Neurons have membranes and communicate using electrical and chemical signals.
doesNotKnow: Vesicle fusion releases neurotransmitter into the synaptic cleft, the extracellular gap between the cells.

misconception: Neuronal signals and chemical synapses involve no ion movement.
objective: Explain the specified step of neuronal signaling under the stated conditions.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: When a neurotransmitter-containing vesicle fuses with the presynaptic membrane, where is its soluble neurotransmitter released? Vesicle fusion releases neurotransmitter into the synaptic cleft, the extracellular gap between the cells.
The diagrams are schematic, show only selected particles or steps, and do not represent actual particle trajectories or scale.
Recall: Where is neurotransmitter released by a presynaptic vesicle? Vesicle fusion releases soluble neurotransmitter into the synaptic cleft.

recall.question: Where is neurotransmitter released by a presynaptic vesicle?
recall.why: Vesicle fusion releases soluble neurotransmitter into the synaptic cleft.
